story: Show HN: I invented a caffeinated toothpaste
text: I don't think caffeine has many negative health implications. Although it has certainly wasted my time by leaving me too jittery to work. There is a great cgp grey video on caffeine: [VIDEO]

I occasionally quit caffeine as a way to recalibrate the tolerance that develops over time. But, within certain limits (my general consumption is 1-2 coffees a day, sometimes 3-4 if super tired or when exercising), there's very few negatives for most people, and quite a number of benefits. Nice explanatory video on the matter: [VIDEO]

story: Silicon Valley is high on innovation. And pot
text: You've reminded me of this video talking about coffee now: [VIDEO] Is there really any good reason why I shouldn't be drinking a lot of coffee? story: How Your Brain Becomes Addicted to Caffeine
text: The article doesn't seem to mention whether coffee is healthy or not. One thing is if it is addictive, but if it is healthy (or even if it just isn't unhealthy), I've got to ask... so what if it is addictive? [VIDEO]
